description: This file defines the class CURLStringFile, which extends CURLFile to provide a way to upload string data as a file in PHP cURL operations. It includes logic for setting and getting the 'data' property, encoding data as base64 in a data URI, and handling relevant type checks.

classes.name: CURLStringFile
classes.description: A subclass of CURLFile enabling in-memory string data to be treated as a file upload for PHP cURL requests.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a CURLStringFile instance with string data, a filename, and MIME type, encoding the data as a data URI.

methods.name: __set
methods.description: Sets the value of properties, specifically handling the 'data' property with validation and encoding.

methods.name: __isset
methods.description: Checks if a property (e.g., 'data') is set.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a property.
